extracted.name: Finnish Long Drink
extracted.description: Also known as Lonkero, this Finnish Long Drink recipe is for a popular highball with gin, grapefruit and lemon juices named after the glass it's served in.
ingredient_lines: 3 ounces grapefruit flavored soda (such as Fresca®)
0.5 fluid ounce freshly squeezed lemon juice
1 splash club soda, or as needed
instruction_lines: Fill a highball glass with ice. Add grapefruit soda, grapefruit juice, gin, and lemon juice; stir to combine. Top with club soda, lightly stir, and garnish with grapefruit slice.
